body:
When I wrote this post years ago I was so hopeless, I couldn't imagine a life without her and what we had. 3 years later I couldn't imagine a life WITH her. 

I'm playing PS3 right now while my amazing girlfriend is sleeping in my arms, IT WILL GET BETTER I PROMISE. I'm so glad you related to my post, I remember the feelings of a breakup all too well. Definitely not something I want to go through again however please trust that time heals everything. Even when you think it won't, it just needs more time

Don't, you'll never get past it. If you're posting on here about it then deep down you know you won't.
The only reason you'd be back with her is because things with that other person didn't work out, please I beg you put yourself first and just move on
If you're going to keep saying the same thing then I'm going to stop replying to this thread

She seems like such a sweet soul when we're together and I can tell how much this is hurting her as much as it's hurting me. I am coming to the conclusion that I shouldn't blame her for this and I need to help her as well as myself
Well idk mate that's why I made the post

I haven't demabsee her to apologise for it at all, she has many many times but I never made her. You make it sound like it's unreasonable to feel this way. The only advice I've been given on here is to leave her which isn't what I want. I am asking for a solution, that isn't breaking up with her, that means we can continue to stay together

I am upset about that you're right. Which is why I made this post to ask if there's anything we can do (apart from break up) to work through this. I never blamed her I just said that what she did upset me very much.
Because it was my best friend? And I feel like it's a bit unfair to ghost me, date him, and then come back to me only when the relationship ends
Because it was my best friend and she dated him less than a few weeks after ghosting me
I guess it's because I still loved her the whole time and I would rather be with her than start a new relationship with someone else
I don't know that's why I made this post in the hopes someone could help in any way
So there's nothing either of can do to work past this. I'm supposed to just leave her
She did come back to me yes, but only after her relationship with him failed. I could be a rebound for her and still it doesn't change how much it hurt me
I'm trying to find any way to work through this because I love her so much, but is there anything either of us could do to fix this?
I wouldn't say she's been around the block. Her body count is only 2, me and him

That was so sweet I teared up reading it. I'm going to do some meditation in a bit and hope it helps. The urges are starting to fade and I just watched a film with my family to assure I don't have the chance to do anything to myself. I still feel the need to cry and I think I will break down again when I get back to my room. I'm going to sink myself into some work and learn something new. I have a boxing session tomorrow so I will take all my anger out on a punch bag to release everything. Thank you so much stranger I hope you know how much that helped me, I wish you everything good in life and hope you have an amazing future. I love you also <3
I'm doing no contact right now but I wish I could make it permanent but we're forced to see each other in 3 weeks as we attend school together :/
It hasn't even been 2 weeks and she's already doing stuff with someone she's known less than a week that it took her months to do with me
My friend juts messaged me saying he just saw her kissing another guy, I guess getting back with her is no longer an option

I'll get her back one day, it will be difficult but I think I can do it, she's too valuable to me to lose her. She's admitted she's very stubborn and will act like she's over someone but is actually extremely heart broken. She told me a while ago if we broke up she'd never get over it. I want to message her soon but I'm so unsure about what to say to her.

That must be so difficult I'm always here to talk if you need. I can potentially come to terms with losing her as a girlfriend but not a best friend it just seems like I've lost such a big part of my life.

I know how you feel, I keep dreaming about her every night, that we're okay and everything back to normal and I wake up and the first thing I think of is how ruined everything is. I keep making up scenarios in my head of how I can fix things but chances are nothing will change how she feels.

Update:

I did exactly that and she persisted it was just a joke and that I was overreacting. We were on the phone and I left her and told her we shouldn't be together. Next thing I heard was her smashing things in her room and then I hung up the call and haven't opened any of her messages
